**Linux Mint 22.x / Ubuntu 24.04 · amd64 · X11 — package revision 2026.10.13-2**

**The updated Windows version will follow.** Older Windows downloads do not contain this native-menu update.

### Updated in revision 2
- Boshy receives keyboard focus at startup, including when the live tracker appears later. Focus remains freely changeable afterward.
- Fix new-run startup when the game has created a metadata-only save stub. Existing saves remain protected.
- Compact BR3 seeds: **18 characters instead of 603** for standard settings, including settings and checksum. Custom configurations may need longer codes; existing BR2 codes remain importable.
- Improved seed dialog with larger code text, character count, adaptive layout and invalid-code feedback.

### Install or update
Download `boshy-randomizer_2026.10.13-2_amd64.deb` from Assets below, then run:
```sh
sudo apt install ./boshy-randomizer_2026.10.13-2_amd64.deb
```
Wine and Lutris are installed as dependencies. Close the randomizer before updating. User saves are stored separately and preserved. Launch Boshy Randomizer from your applications menu; on first launch, select your own Boshy folder or ZIP. Setup creates a private game copy and installs checksum-verified Wine Staging 11.2 WoW64. Internet is required for dependencies and the initial runner download. **The original game is not included.** Existing development installations are not automatically migrated.

### Included
- Original animated game menu with three independent saves and save summaries.
- Randomizer and Target Select modes, advanced routes and shareable seeds.
- Mixed item/character rewards, optional character and projectile randomization.
- Comfort/training settings, separate live tracker and Ctrl+Alt+D diagnostics.
- Automatic English, German, Russian, Spanish and Japanese UI, with English fallback. Update logs stay English.
- First-run folder/ZIP import and private Wine prefix.

### Verification
**41 automated tests passed**, including randomized seed round trips and compatibility checks. Revision 2 was started in a separate local test installation: Boshy remained active while the tracker was visible. The first revision's fresh installation, folder/ZIP import, new-run start and same-save resume were verified in a resource-limited Linux Mint 22.3 VM; that VM test was not repeated for revision 2. This remains a **release candidate**: full gameplay, every special boss exit and performance testing remain open.

[Installation and data locations](https://github.com/THXel/Boshy-Randomizer/blob/v2026.10.13-rc1/docs/LINUX_PACKAGE.md) · [Verification details](https://github.com/THXel/Boshy-Randomizer/blob/v2026.10.13-rc1/docs/RELEASE_PREPARATION.md)
